title: From DQI to C-DQI: Automatic Codebook Generation and Evaluation for Measuring Computational Discourse Quality Index
abstract: arXiv:2610.27937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective democratic deliberation is vital for civic engagement and the health of legislative institutions. However, assessing parliamentary discourse quality is traditionally done using expert-scored, theory-based codebooks (CBs), which are rigid, labor-intensive, and prone to biases. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable alternative for both schema induction and discourse annotation, ensuring schema quality and mitigating models' inherent bias remains a clear challenge. In this work, we propose a complete protocol for LLM-based codebook generation and evaluation. Starting from the widely accepted discourse quality Index (DQI), we compare top-down (theory-based), bottom-up (data-driven), and hybrid approaches for generating context-adapted schemas. translated_title: 从DQI到C-DQI：用于测量计算式话语质量指数的自动编码本生成与评估
translated_abstract: 有效的民主协商对于公民参与和立法机构的健康发展至关重要。然而，评估议会话语质量传统上依赖于专家评分的、基于理论的编码本（CB），这种方法僵化、劳动密集且容易产生偏见。虽然大语言模型（LLM）为模式归纳和话语标注提供了可扩展的替代方案，但如何确保模式质量并减轻模型固有偏见仍然是一个明确的挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个完整的基于LLM的编码本生成与评估协议。从广受认可的话语质量指数（DQI）出发，我们比较了自上而下（基于理论）、自下而上（数据驱动）和混合式三种生成情境适配模式的方法。为了评估这些模式，我们定义了一个由人工标注验证的外在代理指标，以及一个内在的模型间一致性（IMA）指标，该指标利用了不同……
tldr: 该论文提出了一套从DQI到C-DQI的完整协议，通过比较自上而下、自下而上和混合三种方法自动生成基于大语言模型的编码本，并结合人工验证的外在代理指标和模型间一致性（IMA）指标进行评估，从而以可扩展、低偏见的方式测量议会话语质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a complete protocol from DQI to C-DQI that automatically generates LLM-based codebooks via top-down, bottom-up, and hybrid approaches, evaluated through a manually validated extrinsic proxy measure and an intrinsic inter-model agreement (IMA) metric, enabling scalable and less biased assessment of parliamentary discourse quality.
